params.body:
## What

Transport becomes a switch on the garage, decided by one native Laravel Gate.

- **Switch**: `dealers.transport_enabled` (boolean, default off). An administrator sets it on the garage sheet (Beheer > Garages > a garage, tab "Garage", switch "Transport" above the module 1 block). `DealerController::update` drops the field for anyone who is not an administrator, on every route (own sheet, delegated access).
- **Gate** `use-transport` in `AuthServiceProvider`: `isAdmin() || dealer->transport_enabled`. The only place the rule lives.
- **Routes**: all `transport.*` routes and the pay link carry `can:use-transport`. Back from Mollie (`transport.return`) and the status poll stay open to the owner, so a payment that was started lands even if the switch moved.
- **Access middleware**: `Access::GATED` maps the security key `transport` to the Gate. For that key the role row is not asked; the Gate answers and an allowed user gets view/add/edit.
- **Menu**: new nullable `menus.ability`. `Menu::scopeVisibleTo` (used by `MenuRepository::byAccess`, `childsByAccess` and `childsWithAccess`) shows an item with an ability when that Gate allows, regardless of `role_access`; items without ability behave exactly as before. The migration sets `ability = 'use-transport'` on the menu row with security `transport`.
- **Truck**: `Vehicle::ShowTransport` = Gate and complete sheet. It no longer hides without accepted conditions; `CanBeTransported` adds the conditions.
- **Conditions first** (R S4-10.19): the request window shows the five conditions (accepted ones locked) until all five are accepted; `transport.store.conditions` accepts them (422 unless all five ticked); `transport.store` answers 422 before acceptance.

## Why

Transport hung on the role right of the menu `transport`, which only the administrator role carried. Roles are shared by hundreds of garages, so one garage could not be let in without its whole role. Separately, the conditions check counted only rows with a value other than 1, so a dealer who never saved the conditions counted as having accepted all five (bevinding: transportvoorwaarden-zonder-rij-golden-als-aanvaard).

## Rules

- New: R S4-10.18 (garage switch and Gate), R S4-10.19 (conditions first).
- Updated: R S4-10.1, R S4-10.17, R P2-1.7.
- Fixes bevinding transportvoorwaarden-zonder-rij-golden-als-aanvaard.

## Tests

- `TransportIsAGarageSwitchTest` (11): Gate; without the switch every transport route refuses and there is no truck on the customer order; with the switch the truck is there and a dealer without any role right requests; administrator always; Mollie return and status open, pay link 403; menu items with an ability follow the Gate, those without follow the role table; conditions first, 4 of 5 refused, 5 of 5 accepted; conditions only for an own vehicle; administrator sets the switch, a dealer cannot.
- `TransportChainTest`, `TransportFromADealerTransactionTest`, `ListPageHeadersTest`: fixtures give the garages the switch; the dealer-transaction test now checks that without conditions the truck opens the conditions step, and that a garage without the switch gets no truck.
- Full suite locally: 2410 tests green. PHPStan: no errors (baseline entries for `MenuRepository` and `Menu::childsWithAccess` removed, now typed).

## After merge

The migration leaves every garage off. Switch transport on per garage on its sheet.
params.title: Transport is a garage switch behind one Gate
